editorial_rules: Do not frame modeled prevalence as a simple ranking of which countries are mentally healthier.
Separate measured service resources from modeled disorder prevalence and explain their different data-generating processes.
Country observations from WHO GHO can come from different reporting years; show the year whenever a country value is exposed.
Missing country observations remain missing and are never treated as zero.
The 2015 depression prevalence × latest psychiatrist-density layer is descriptive historical context only, not a current need score or causal estimate.
Do not collapse workforce, spending, facilities, prevalence or treatment coverage into an opaque composite country score.
Keep suicide separate from the mental-disorder prevalence total unless the metric definition explicitly includes it.
Every numeric narrative claim must retain a source or claim_ref before publication.
